Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** a zh-CN author's report or dataset gets the Name `field` from a Chinese label, where the object designer asks for one.
- **For the claimant:** Match the object designer's derivation (an empty Name, so the author is asked). Serial with PR #12788 (#12746) on the same two inspectors.

Claim: PM loop round 2
Session: `session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12789-label-derives-empty-name`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12789`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#3`
File surface: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` and `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`, the Label handler's Name derivation and the `nameFollowsLabel` comparison only, so that a Label yielding no machine name leaves the Name empty, as `ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx` does; a helper in `previews/object-fields-io.ts` only if an empty-on-empty strict form must be shared from there (⛔ `toFieldName`'s own `'field'` fallback is not changed, because other callers rely on it); tests beside each; one `.changeset/12789-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the named paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (designer only; no export, prop or type changes)
Responsibility: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s report and dataset designers derive Name from the Label with `toFieldName`, whose empty result falls back to the string `field` (`object-fields-io.ts:269`), so a Label in a non-Latin script, or a cleared Label, names the item `field` silently | none covers it | every author who labels a new report or dataset in a non-Latin script, measured in Chromium with the Label 收入 by the objectui#12746 dev (PR #12788); the derivations stand on `main` `f114263` (`ReportDefaultInspector.tsx:510`, `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx:522`)
Thread-read: 6224590925
Serial constraints cleared: PR objectui#12788 (objectui#12746, this seat), which triage named as serial, landed `94b2489`. No in-flight `domain:ui` claim and no open objectui PR names `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`, `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` or `object-fields-io.ts`, read across the lane's `pm:dispatched` claims and all 7 open PRs' file lists 2026-10-16T21:33Z.
